description: See your finished Editor render at the seconds you name: one still per second comes back as a picture, in the order asked (20 per answer; any more come back named in still_to_look_at for the next call). render_id.description: Which render: an export_id from export_editor_project or a render id or job id from the project's Renders. Leave out for the newest finished render.

seconds.description: The moments to look at, in seconds from the start.
